cases.title: The starter about AI agents
cases.question: How does Brad ship with AI agents?
cases.answer: Brad's approach is described in the essay on running VINDecoded. The core of it is that AI agents write most of the code and Brad reviews and approves the work. The system around the agents includes docs every agent reads before it starts, one isolated checkout per agent, tests the coding agent can't rewrite, a second agent that reviews its work, a gate and a kill switch on every new feature, and one audited door to production. The work waits for Brad's review and approval. When the code is done, a second agent reviews it with fresh context and only read tools, so it can't quietly fix what it finds. Releases are a separate, pinned step. Merging to master deploys nothing. A release happens only when Brad asks for one.
